summary: Iteration 3 end-to-end verification of REAL Gmail SMTP send, Client Portal auth + strict data isolation, CRM sync graceful placeholder, live-social publish fallback, and Settings rename. Backend: 29/29 pytest passing in ~15s (adds 7 new iter-3 tests, 2 stale sendgrid-based tests updated to reflect provider consolidation into 'email'). Real email SEND to ekodecrux@gmail.com succeeded via seeded SMTP vault (status=sent). Email vault seeded connection verified as 'Connected' with masked hints (smtp_password hint starts with '••••', from_name hint ends with 'ting' for AIMarketing) and never leaks plaintext. Portal user creation, login, /auth/me returns role='client' + client_id. Portal isolation: as client user — GET /api/leads and /api/campaigns return only that client's records (verified against seeded lead/campaign in a different client + unscoped lead), /api/analytics/overview scoped to client (total_leads=1, campaigns=1), and /api/clients + /api/connections (GET & POST) return 403. Owner scoping unchanged: admin sees all + can filter by client_id. CRM sync: {provider:'hubspot'} without creds → 400 'not configured'; unsupported provider → 400. Social publish: LinkedIn schedule → publish without vault creds → status=Published + published_mode='simulated'. Regression: auth (login/logout/register/me/unauth), strategy (Groq JSON), content text + Gemini image data URL, lead CRUD + AI score, sales assist AI, campaigns derived metrics, social generate/schedule/publish/delete, clients CRUD + scoped counts, integrations providers list (11 providers, 'email' replaces 'sendgrid'), connections encryption Partial→Connected→Delete with meta_ads, client-scoped hubspot connection, real scrape (stripe.com/notion.so), CSV import mapping title→role. Frontend E2E (real browser): admin login → /settings sidebar item renders and shows 'Connected' for email seeded card → Clients: add-client-btn + save-client-btn creates client → portal-login-* opens modal, portal-email + portal-password + create-portal-user-btn creates login → Leads: add lead, sync-crm-btn shows placeholder toast (HubSpot/Zoho/Settings text present) → Sales Assistant: select lead, sales-action-follow_up_email generates AI content, send-email-btn appears → logout → portal user login → client-portal-badge visible → sidebar-nav-clients + sidebar-nav-settings absent (NAV_CLIENT reduced menu) → Leads page shows 0 rows for the new empty client (data isolation confirmed in UI).

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount — non-blocking, tracked since iter-1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_email_connection only inserts when 'email' provider row absent — if an owner (or a test) deletes the seeded email connection, it will not be re-seeded until backend restart. Consider re-seeding on every startup OR guarding DELETE /api/connections/email at platform scope to preserve the platform default (or add a POST /api/connections/email/reset). Actual bug that hit this iteration: iteration-2 regression test deleted ALL connected providers including the seeded 'email', which required a backend restart to re-seed. Test has been updated to skip 'email' during cleanup.

server.py /api/sales/send-email is behind role check only via _owner (client role can also call because there is NO _require_owner). This is intentional so portal clients could send emails, but currently portal users can email leads that BELONG to the owner-scope but are NOT their own client_id — line 787 fetches lead by _id without filtering by client_id for role='client'. Recommendation: add client scope check: if user.role=='client' and lead.client_id != user.client_id -> 403. Same applies to /api/leads/{lid}/score, /api/leads/{lid}/stage, DELETE /api/leads/{lid}, campaigns metrics/toggle/delete, sales/assist. Currently portal users can potentially mutate other clients' leads/campaigns if they know the _id. Data leakage is filtered on LIST endpoints but not on ID-addressed mutation endpoints.

server.py /api/social/schedule and /api/social/posts/{pid}/publish do NOT persist or filter by client_id — portal users share the same list. If multi-tenant social posting is required for the portal, add client scoping (currently N/A because portal NAV_CLIENT does not include Social).

integrations_live.send_email: SMTP call is synchronous inside asyncio.to_thread with a 25s socket timeout — acceptable but no retry. If Gmail SMTP is transient-flaky the send returns 502 to the client. Consider a single retry.
secrets_store.py: still no clean startup guard if CREDENTIALS_KEY missing — encrypt() will raise AttributeError on None._fernet. Non-blocking (env is set).

server.py list_connections builds q['client_id'] = client_id if client_id else None — good isolation; but delete_connection does the same, so DELETE with no client_id will only delete platform-scoped rows. Fine.
ObjectId(xxx) still not wrapped in try/except (clients/leads/campaigns/social) — malformed IDs raise 500 not 400 (carried from iter-1).
test_credentials: admin@marketing.ai / admin123. Portal user created per-run e.g. portal_ui_<ts>@test.com / portal123.
seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_UIClient_<ts>, TEST_SalesLead_<ts>, TEST_MineLead/OtherLead/UnscopedLead + campaigns; cleaned up by fixtures/finally. UI test leaves a few TEST_UIClient_* and a lead — acceptable as demo. Real email 'AIMarketing iteration 3 test' was delivered to ekodecrux@gmail.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 29/29 pytest pass in ~15s. Real send goes through Gmail SMTP for ekodecrux@gmail.com only (do not add other real recipients). If seed 'email' connection is missing at startup (e.g. deleted), restart backend to re-seed. Iter-3 introduced potential authz gap: mutation endpoints on leads/campaigns/etc. do not enforce client_id scope for role='client' — recommended to add scope filter on ID-addressed writes if the portal user threat model matters. Frontend testids used: sidebar-nav-{settings,clients,leads,sales}, add-client-btn, save-client-btn, portal-login-<id>, portal-email, portal-password, create-portal-user-btn, sync-crm-btn, sales-lead-select, sales-action-follow_up_email, send-email-btn, client-portal-badge.
rca of the issue: Two stale iter-2 tests failed initially because iter-3 (a) consolidated 'sendgrid' → 'email' provider, so any test that referenced 'sendgrid' by name was invalid, and (b) the platform-scope cleanup loop in TestConnections deleted the seeded 'email' connection, which broke TestEmailVaultSeeded + TestRealEmailSend downstream (because backend only re-seeds on startup). FIX: (1) providers list expected list now checks 'email' instead of 'sendgrid'; (2) test_save_partial_and_connected rewritten to use 'meta_ads' provider (2 fields); (3) TestConnections cleanup now skips provider=='email'; (4) TestEmailVaultSeeded skips 'email' from the all-Pending assertion. After the restart-and-fix, backend re-seeded email and all 29 tests pass.
